constraint_results.judge_reason: The implementation uses a nested helper function _redact_mapping that recursively processes nested dictionaries (when isinstance(value, dict) is true, it calls _redact_mapping(value) recursively). It maintains a count of redacted keys using a nonlocal counter that increments each time a sensitive key is found. After the recursive redaction completes, it calls orgops.auditing.write_event('redaction.applied', keys_redacted=count) with the total count of redacted keys. Both required behaviors are present.
